battles.laneBookNote: Lane Genealogies (Vol. 1): Mary Lane (b. 6 Dec. 1734) m. 1 Jan. 1756 Capt. James Prescott of Hampton Falls (b. 5 Dec. 1733); compilation calls him a lieutenant in the army of the Revolution and notes long selectman service. Son Ebenezer Prescott (b. 6 June 1756) is described as a soldier in the Revolution, then a farmer in Pittsfield (d. 26 June 1834, ae. 78). These are Prescott-surname and in-law lines—verify service with Compiled Military Service Records and pensions; do not treat compilation phrasing as muster-roll proof for Mary Lane herself.
